sources.entry: Sunscreen - Sunscreen is a fun, lightweight application that changes your desktop wallpaper based on sunrise and sunset.

summary.one_liner: Sunscreen is a lightweight macOS menu bar app that changes the desktop wallpaper automatically based on sunrise and sunset.
summary.what_it_does: Sunscreen lets you drag and drop wallpapers into its preferences and switches the desktop background as the day progresses. It supports five periods of the day (sunrise, morning, afternoon, sunset, and nighttime), each with its own wallpaper. A period can be left empty to skip it, in which case the previous period's wallpaper is reused; for example, an empty Afternoon uses the Morning wallpaper. The app runs only in the menu bar and does not add an icon to the Dock.
use_cases: automatically change wallpaper by time of day
day and night desktop background switcher
sunrise and sunset wallpaper changer for Mac
customize desktop background for each part of the day
how_to_run: Clone the repository and build the app in Xcode
Or purchase Sunscreen on the App Store
notable: Five separate wallpaper slots: sunrise, morning, afternoon, sunset, nighttime
Empty periods inherit the previous period's wallpaper
Menu bar only, no Dock icon
caveats: Source build requires Xcode; the README suggests purchasing on the App Store if you use the app
